We need to apply template 1679747 to the molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2). The template is given in mapped_rxn: 'O=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([O:7][CH3:8])[cH:9][cH:10]1)[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][c:14]([O:15][CH3:16])[cH:17][cH:18]1.[Li][CH2:1][Si](C)(C)C>>[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([O:7][CH3:8])[cH:9][cH:10]1)[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][c:14]([O:15][CH3:16])[cH:17][cH:18]1'

So forward reaction: a carbonyl (O= C) attached to aromatic rings plus LiCH2Si(C)(C)C gives product: CH2= C( aromatic ) aromatic (i.e., a stilbene with methoxy groups). The template is a retrosynthetic transformation: break the double bond to give a carbonyl and a LiCH2Si(C)(C)C (i.e., a silyl carbanion). So applying to target molecule (the initial_molecule) should give precursors: a carbonyl compound (probably a benzophenone derivative) and LiCH2Si(C)(C)C.

We need to use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles = initial_molecule and template_id = 1679747.

Let's call apply_template.
